I can't answer these from the declarations. `camera-api.d.ts` only gives types: `ArcRotateKeyboardOptions` (key mappings, `angularSensitivity`, `panningSensitivity`, `zoomingSensitivity`) and `enableArcRotateKeyboardControls(): void`. Nothing shows how simultaneous keys combine, whether Alt or Ctrl switch the mode, or how per-frame deltas are computed. I also can't run the scene here, so I haven't measured anything. I've left the values as `null` rather than guess.

I can't write to disk in this session, so here is the content for the file:

FILE: app/notes/arrow-keys.json
```json
{ "rotateFraction": null, "altFraction": null, "ctrlSameDistance": null }
```

To get real values, you'd need either the library's keyboard-controls source (the implementation behind `enableArcRotateKeyboardControls`) or a run in a browser with the scene. For the run, log `camera.alpha` and `camera.target` each frame for each of the six key combinations (Right, Right+Up, Alt+Right, Alt+Right+Up, Ctrl+Right, Ctrl+Right+Up) over 60 frames, then compute the ratios and compare the target displacements.
